ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Queer Latinidades. This course uses queer and queerness as a framework to understand various Latina/o identities that exist outside of the mainstream. Queerness, in this course, is not limited to a certain set of sexual and gender identities (LGBT), but is an idea that helps interrogate who gets to be counted as “legitimately” and “authentically” Latina/o and who is denied this. In particular, we will take an in-depth look at transgressive Latina/o sexualities and gender identities, blackness, indigeneity, and disability.
